preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists of lowercase English letters only.

postconditions.description: Each line of output contains exactly two items: the length of the resulting string and the string itself.
If the resulting string is longer than 10 characters, it is truncated to show the first 5 characters, then '...', then the last 2 characters.
The output is sorted by the length of the resulting string in descending order, and by the length of the string itself in case of a tie.
